awz_reference: existing Trajectory2D.eval_pos_and_tangent at 25 equally spaced arclength positions, height0, analytic-only small-room path, not rendered scene or public perception test

filter_bound: Bpred=Bprev+||d_odom||2; Bnext=||I-K||2 Bpred+||K||2 ||d_obs||2; exact in translation subspace; report every step and numeric slack separately
graph_reference_assumptions: anchor node0 fixed (chosen gauge, not observation/truth claim), fixed known rotations, relative translations with bounded error; connected full-rank reduced incidence matrix A
graph_bound: ||xhat-xtrue||2 <= ||pinv(sqrt(W) A)||2 ||sqrt(W)e||2; exact linear subgroup only; reference uses uniform weight1, each odometry edge fixed bias, closing loop displacement known exactly
graph_nonlin: small SE2/SE3 Gauss-Newton; report rank/gauge/condition and convergence, no global optimum claim; absent anchor or rank deficiency raises observability error
scope_exclusion: G3 canonicalization operator not implemented. Only known point/vector group actions and gravity state; no RGB warp, no sensors/teacher/MLX.
